original_test_intent: Validate an approved IPv4 configuration and reachability on a dedicated BlueField port, then verify address/link and physical LED behavior when its cable is removed and after restoration.
original_method: Map a non-management interface to physical port/peer; approve IP/prefix/gateway/ping target and prove no duplicate; save exact pre-state; operator applies temporary configuration and cable actions while full link/address/route/ping plus visual LEDs are recorded; restore cable and original configuration.
manual_activity: Network owner approves a disposable address and dedicated port; operator applies it, removes/restores cable, observes LEDs and owns recovery/verdict.
required_inputs: Alternate access and exact rollback snapshot
safety_requirements: Never mutate the sole management interface
Stop on duplicate IP, route drift, access loss or wrong port; no auto-retry
agent_execution_scope: Do not make unapproved changes or verdict
engineer_actions: Approve dedicated port and network plan

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `ip addr add` is only one approved phase; sshpass, assumed /24 and missing route/duplicate/cable/LED/rollback controls make it unsafe as written.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use an operator-approved secure local/session change on the exact interface, with captured pre-state and explicit rollback; automation collects full ip/link/route/ping evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: IPv4 assignment, ping, cable removal, LED on/off and 10-minute allocations are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Treat this as a reversible temporary network transaction tied to a dedicated port, plus synchronized physical cable/LED evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds ownership, duplicate detection, exact prefix/routes, alternate access and deterministic restoration.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Applying an address alone does not test cable removal, physical indication or cleanup.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong interface/address can disrupt production or management; cable removal requires local operator.

project_override_considerations: Owner must define whether address should disappear or merely remain configured with carrier down, exact prefix/routes, ping success oracle and required final cleanup state.
expected_evidence: Exact port/network plan and duplicate check
Operator LED-on/off photos/witness and cable timestamps
